exposure: Breastfeeding duration in the first session
cohort: Patients who delivered at the study institution during April and May 2020
finding: High-risk pregnancies, cesarean delivery, and delaying breastfeeding beyond 30 minutes after birth were associated with lower LATCH scores, indicating poorer breastfeeding outcomes.
mod_finding: Patients who delivered by cesarean section had a higher odds ratio of having a LATCH score lower than 8.
